subject: pathology
title: Autoimmune diseases: tolerance failure and systemic patterns

steps.tx: Autoimmunity develops when tolerance to self antigens fails in susceptible people. **Central tolerance** deletes strongly reactive cells in the thymus and marrow, and **peripheral tolerance** controls cells that escape into tissues. Genetic susceptibility, especially HLA type, combines with infection, ultraviolet light and other triggers to produce disease.
steps.say: Autoimmunity develops when tolerance to self antigens fails in susceptible people. Central deletion is active early because strongly reactive lymphocytes are removed in marrow. Peripheral mechanisms are important because they control autoreactive cells in tissues. Genes and triggers are combined in practice and they precipitate clinical disease together.

steps.tx: Systemic lupus erythematosus is the prototype multisystem autoimmune disease in young women. **Antinuclear antibody** is sensitive for lupus, and **anti double stranded DNA** antibodies are more specific and track activity. Immune complexes deposit with complement activation, and skin, joints, kidney, serosa and blood cells are injured.
steps.say: Lupus is a multisystem disease and it mainly affects young women in relapses. Antinuclear antibody is sensitive whereas anti DNA antibody is more specific. Immune complexes deposit in tissues and complement is activated during flares. Skin, joints, kidney and blood cells are commonly injured.

rows: Best screening test; negative makes lupus unlikely

steps.tx: Renal histology in lupus determines the intensity of immunosuppressive treatment. Proliferative disease shows **wire loop deposits** from subendothelial complexes, and **membranous lupus nephritis** shows subepithelial deposits with nephrotic syndrome. Full house immunofluorescence staining supports lupus strongly, and diffuse proliferative disease requires aggressive treatment promptly.
steps.say: Lupus nephritis is classified by biopsy because histology determines treatment intensity. Wire loop deposits are subendothelial and they indicate severe proliferative disease. Membranous disease is different because subepithelial deposits cause nephrotic syndrome. Full house staining is supportive because multiple immune reactants are present.

steps.tx: This glomerulus shows proliferative lupus nephritis with thick wire loop deposits. **Wire loop deposits** are subendothelial immune complexes, and the bright **immunofluorescence** inset confirms immune deposition along capillary walls. This severe pattern matters because it requires aggressive immunosuppression and is a highly tested biopsy distinction in lupus.
steps.say: This glomerulus shows thickened capillary walls with wire loop deposits clearly. The inset is bright because immunofluorescence demonstrates immune deposits along capillary walls. This pattern indicates proliferative disease and it requires aggressive immunosuppression promptly. Biopsy classification is essential because treatment intensity differs greatly.

steps.tx: Sjogren syndrome destroys exocrine glands through lymphocytic infiltration over time. **Sjogren syndrome** causes dry eyes and dry mouth, and antibodies to **Ro and La antigens** are characteristic serological findings. Dental caries and parotid swelling occur commonly, and the risk of lymphoma is increased in affected patients.
steps.say: Sjogren syndrome is destructive because tear and salivary glands are infiltrated gradually. Dry eyes and dry mouth are the dominant symptoms in most patients. Anti Ro and anti La antibodies are characteristic and they support the diagnosis. Lymphoma risk is increased and surveillance is therefore important.

steps.tx: Systemic sclerosis combines autoimmunity, vasculopathy and fibrosis of skin and organs. Limited disease shows **CREST features** with anticentromere antibody, and diffuse disease carries **anti Scl 70 antibody** with greater lung and renal risk. Raynaud phenomenon is usually the earliest clue and precedes skin thickening by months or years.
steps.say: Systemic sclerosis is complex because autoimmunity occurs with vessel injury and fibrosis. Limited disease is associated with anticentromere antibody and CREST features clinically. Diffuse disease is associated with anti Scl 70 and greater internal organ risk. Raynaud phenomenon is earliest and it precedes skin thickening.
